statement: The resolver has no 'not yet in force / not yet inserted' state. For a date before the creating instrument existed or commenced, it returns the only located version as the sole candidate. This presents the latest version as applying, which breaks the claim that it 'never assumes the latest version applies', and it fails the required 1 July 2024 boundary check on the BNS/BNSS/BSA side.
evidence: candidates_at(): BNS2023 whole / s.358 / BNSS2023 s.531 on 2024-06-30 and on 1990-01-01 -> [v01] only. AFT2007 s.9A (Finance Act 2017) on 1950-01-01 -> [s.9A/v01]. AA1950 s.169A (Act 37/1992) on 1950-01-01 -> [v01]. AR1954 r.59A (S.R.O. 246/1982), r.13A, r.15A on 1950 -> [v01]. Only versions with a STATED start (e.g. r.16A-C, r.170A/B) are excluded correctly. tests/ do not exercise pre-commencement dates.
requested_action: Add an explicit NOT_YET_IN_FORCE / PROVISION_NOT_YET_CREATED candidate whenever the first version's start is not established for that date, and exclude it only when a stated start precedes the date. Add tests for BNS on 2024-06-30, AFT s.9A in 2010 and AA s.169A in 1990. Re-review before the resolver is used by any downstream tool.

statement: The resolver ignores retrospective_deemed_effect_from. A version that the instrument itself deems effective from an earlier date is excluded for that deemed window.
evidence: AR1954/r.16A/v03 and AR1954/r.2/v03 (S.R.O. 216/1988, effective_from 1988-09-17, retrospective_deemed_effect_from 1979-06-04). candidates_at(r.16A, 1985-01-01) -> [v01]; candidates_at(r.2, 1985-01-01) -> [v02]. v03 is not returned, although adviser question A4-ADV-078 (AQ-06) leaves the retrospective effect open.
requested_action: For dates within [retrospective_deemed_effect_from, effective_from), return the deemed version as a candidate with reason 'retrospective deemed effect; AQ-06 open'. Add a test.

statement: The resolver uses no lower bound from the creating instrument. Omissions and repeals are returned as candidates decades before the instrument existed, so the 1992 Army Act boundary checks give no discrimination at any date.
evidence: AA1950 s.75, s.76, s.127 and Chapter XVI: v02 (omission by Act 37 of 1992, published 1992-09-07; record notes 'no commencement section printed (pp.1-4 read)', so no retrospective wording) is returned for 1960-01-01, 1992-09-05 and 2000-01-01, alongside v01. IPC1860 whole v02 (BNS s.358 repeal) is returned for 1990-01-01.
requested_action: Use instrument_date/publication_date as an exclusion floor (not as commencement) unless retrospective wording is recorded. Keep both versions open for dates after publication while commencement is NOT_STATED_PENDING_ADVICE.
